en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy outdoor market scene in a large cobblestoned square. Numerous people in late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century clothing stand among stalls and carts loaded with goods, many drawn by horses. Behind the market are long, neoclassical two‑storey buildings and, to the right, a more ornate multi‑storey building with towers. The caption "Pori - Björneborg" appears in the lower margin.
